name: convalescent-tonic-sacrifice-bottom-draw-recover
notes: Convalescent Tonic is seeded directly onto the field (its own Sacrifice ability doesn't care how it got there, and Brewing isn't the clause under test). activateAbilityAbilities['l8ao8bls6g:0'] offers an MZMULTICHOOSE of up to 2 hand cards (submitted as the '&'-joined 'myHand-0&myHand-1' response, same shape as essence-crucible-razorgale-calling); customDQHandlers['l8ao8bls6g:0:ActivateAbility-1'] moves the chosen cards to the bottom of the deck, then draws that many back, then RecoverChampion($player, 3). The champion is pre-damaged to 5 so Recover 3 leaves 2 damage remaining. Verified live: initial deck [em6eEh9q8y,em6eEh9q8y,em6eEh9q8y,n8wyfG9hbY,px60u5n1do] (5) ends at [em6eEh9q8y,n8wyfG9hbY,px60u5n1do,px60u5n1do,n8wyfG9hbY] (still 5) -- the two chosen hand cards (px60u5n1do, n8wyfG9hbY) are appended at the BOTTOM (the final two slots), and 2 fresh cards were drawn back into hand from the old deck top.

rulesClauses: Sacrifice Convalescent Tonic: Put up to two cards from your hand on the bottom of your deck then draw that many cards. Recover 3.
